text:
emily: Hi team — opened PR for two doc pieces: a focused migration guide (soft-kms -> HSM rewrap) and an air-gapped install appendix. Split into `docs/migrations/rewrap-keys.md` and `docs/install/airgap-appendix.md`. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4382
jake: Thanks. Quick skim of the rewrap guide: do we want to include both `pkcs11-tool` and an OpenSSL-based example? Some customers have minimal HSM CLIs.
tina: Yes, please both. I drafted an OpenSSL `pkeyutl` example and a `pkcs11-tool` piping example. For `pkcs11-tool` I used `PKCS11_PROVIDER={{ hsm_provider_path }}` template var instead of a hardcoded path.
emily: Good call on the template var. For packaging notes, add Debian path `/usr/lib/redwood/hsm/libpkcs11.so` and RPM path `/opt/redwood/hsm/libpkcs11.so` as examples. Mark them as examples only.
jake: Networking concern in airgap doc: we show a sample private registry on `10.254.10.5:8443`. Add note about cert CNs and containerd requiring `http` => `tls` config; include a snippet for `config.toml` with `[[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".registry.mirrors]]` vs plural `mirrors` — many readers trip on the key name.
tina: Added that fix and a brief troubleshooting section: `ctr images pull` debug steps, curl against the registry using the CA in `/etc/redwood/registry-ca.pem`, and an example `skopeo` login.
infra-bot: CI: docs-linter found 2 warnings and 1 error in PR 4382. Error: missing example rewrap script in `migrations/rewrap-keys.md` (placeholder flagged).
emily: I left a placeholder script in the migrations file intentionally; can someone convert it to a working `rewrap-keys.sh` that performs: export key material (encrypted), connect to HSM, import, re-encrypt, and verify with `client.kms.list_keys()`? Keep it idempotent and add a dry-run flag.
jake: I'll author a minimal, safe rewrap script that uses the Redwood CLI shim: `redwood kms export --key old-key --out tmp.enc && redwood kms import --hsm --in tmp.enc --out new-key`. The shim will call into the HSM client. We'll include the real commands in `scripts/rewrap-keys.example.sh` and mark it as example (not for production).
tina: Also add a small integration test note: `tests/integration/test_rewrap.sh` should run in a HSM-enabled CI stage (tagged `hsm`) and mock providers for local runs. Document the CI tag requirement in the migration guide.
emily: Security note: HSM lib file permissions and SELinux context. Add `chown root:root {{ hsm_provider_path }}` and `chmod 440` plus an SELinux example: `semanage fcontext -a -t etc_t '{{ hsm_provider_path }}' && restorecon -v '{{ hsm_provider_path }}'`. Mention customers using AppArmor too.
jake: SDK snippets: include a Python snippet using env var `PKCS11_PROVIDER` and a Go snippet showing `kms.ProvidePKCS11(path string)`. Keep them tiny; link to the SDK ref.
tina: One small doc-lint error I saw earlier was a bad anchor in the airgap appendix pointing to `#registry-setup-steps`. I added the anchor in the registry section and a tiny ascii sequence diagram showing mirror pull order.
emily: Also tightened wording around management ports — changed any "open port" phrasing to "open internally on the management network (do not expose to public internet)".
infra-bot: docs-linter: warnings cleared after push. Running link checker...
doc-bot: docs-linter: all checks passed. PR merged by emily (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/b3c2a7f)
